record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Topological Algebra
record.original_question: If a paratopological group G is right ω-bounded, must it also be left ω-bounded? Here G is left ω-bounded if for every neighborhood U of the origin there exists a countable subset F of G such that G = F U, and right ω-bounded if for every neighborhood U there exists a countable subset F with G = U F.

evidence.quote:
A paratopological group G is left ω-bounded (resp. right ω-bounded) if for any neighborhood U ⊂ G of the origin there is a countable subset F ⊂ G with G = F U (resp. G = UF); G is ω-bounded if it is both left and right ω-bounded.
Problem 10 (Guran). Is a paratopological group G left ω-bounded if it is right ω-bounded?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a paratopological group, that is, a group endowed with a topology under which the multiplication map $G\times G\to G$, $(x,y)\mapsto xy$, is jointly continuous (the inversion map is not required to be continuous). Denote by $e$ the identity element of $G$. Say that $G$ is:
- left $\omega$-bounded if for every neighborhood $U$ of $e$ in $G$ there exists a countable subset $F\subseteq G$ such that $G = F\cdot U$;
- right $\omega$-bounded if for every neighborhood $U$ of $e$ in $G$ there exists a countable subset $F\subseteq G$ such that $G = U\cdot F$.

Question: Must every right $\omega$-bounded paratopological group be left $\omega$-bounded?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a definitive resolution of Guran's question on whether right $\omega$-boundedness implies left $\omega$-boundedness for paratopological groups. Surveys and follow-up works on paratopological groups (e.g., Tkachenko's "On paratopological groups") discuss related boundedness notions but do not appear to settle this specific equivalence, leaving its status unverified.

status_evidence.title: On paratopological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on paratopological groups discussing boundedness-type properties and open problems.
status_evidence.claim: Related survey does not appear to record a resolution of the right vs left ω-boundedness equivalence.

status_evidence.title: A note on bounded sets and C-compact sets in paratopological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies bounded and C-compact sets in paratopological groups.
status_evidence.claim: Discusses related boundedness concepts but does not resolve Guran's left/right ω-boundedness problem.
